name: Unconstrained Face Sketch Synthesis Benchmark
description: Face sketch generation has attracted much attention in the field of visual computing. However, existing methods either are limited to constrained conditions or heavily rely on various preprocessing steps to deal with in-the-wild cases. In this paper, we argue that accurately perceiving facial region and facial components is crucial for unconstrained sketch synthesis. To this end, we propose a novel Perception-Adaptive Network (PANet), which can generate high-quality face sketches under unconstrained conditions in an end-to-end scheme. Specifically, our PANet is composed of i) a Fully Convolutional Encoder for hierarchical feature extraction, ii) a Face-Adaptive Perceiving Decoder for extracting potential facial region and handling face variations, and iii) a Component-Adaptive Perceiving Module for facial component aware feature representation learning.
